description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log messages by passing only the message content downstream in a logging chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that passes only the message part of log entries to the next LogNode.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chaining.
